source_4 = pd.read_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length9_34/training_4.csv", index_col=0)
source_9 = pd.read_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length9_34/training_9.csv", index_col=0)

# According to operation_history, we join Source9_34_9 with Source9_34_0, Source9_34_1, Source9_34_3, Source9_34_4 on ROW_WID
# Start with source_9 as base
df = source_9

# Join with source_0 on ROW_WID
df = df.merge(source_0, on="ROW_WID", how="left")

# Join with source_1 on ROW_WID
df = df.merge(source_1, on="ROW_WID", how="left")

# Join with source_3 on ROW_WID
df = df.merge(source_3, on="ROW_WID", how="left")

# Join with source_4 on ROW_WID

# According to operation_history, group_by = [] and aggregation = sum(Source9_34_9.KEYWORDS_NUM)
# Since group_by is empty, we sum the KEYWORDS_NUM column over the entire dataframe
# But the target schema only has KEYWORDS_NUM as integer, so we produce a single-row dataframe with sum(KEYWORDS_NUM)

target_df = pd.DataFrame({"KEYWORDS_NUM": [int(keywords_num_sum)]})

# Write the result to the specified path
target_df.to_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length9_34/target_multisource.csv", index=False)

import pandas as pd

# Read all source CSVs with index_col=0
source0 = pd.read_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length9_34/training_0.csv", index_col=0)
source1 = pd.read_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length9_34/training_1.csv", index_col=0)
source2 = pd.read_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length9_34/training_2.csv", index_col=0)
source3 = pd.read_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length9_34/training_3.csv", index_col=0)
source4 = pd.read_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length9_34/training_4.csv", index_col=0)
source5 = pd.read_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length9_34/training_5.csv", index_col=0)
source6 = pd.read_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length9_34/training_6.csv", index_col=0)
source7 = pd.read_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length9_34/training_7.csv", index_col=0)
source8 = pd.read_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length9_34/training_8.csv", index_col=0)
source9 = pd.read_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length9_34/training_9.csv", index_col=0)

# Union the four sources with the same schema (Source9_34_2,5,6,8)
unioned = pd.concat([source2, source5, source6, source8], ignore_index=True)

# Join Source9_34_9 with Source9_34_0 on ROW_WID
df = pd.merge(source9, source0, on="ROW_WID", how="inner")

# Join with Source9_34_1 on ROW_WID
df = pd.merge(df, source1, on="ROW_WID", how="inner")

# Join with Source9_34_3 on ROW_WID
df = pd.merge(df, source3, on="ROW_WID", how="inner")

# Join with Source9_34_4 on ROW_WID
df = pd.merge(df, source4, on="ROW_WID", how="inner")

# Join with unioned dimension table on ROW_WID
df = pd.merge(df, unioned, on="ROW_WID", how="inner")

# The target schema is only ['KEYWORDS_NUM'], so aggregate sum over KEYWORDS_NUM
result = pd.DataFrame()
result["KEYWORDS_NUM"] = [df["KEYWORDS_NUM"].sum()]

# Write output
result.to_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length9_34/target_multisource_critique_history.csv", index=False)
